subject: Error in ectorun(ecto) : NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)

messages.author: dc28b3e0354efd85
messages.subject: Error in ectorun(ecto) : NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)
parts:
Hello,
I'm using the ectotherm and microclimate models  to calculate number of hours where the body temperature exceeds a certain temperature value as well as total and length of longest streak of hours spent above a certain temperature but keep getting this error. Essentially, the code is counting the number of instances where that is TRUE but the loop won't run to completion and I'm stuck. I would appreciate your help. 


Best regards,
Desire

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: Error in ectorun(ecto) : NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)
parts:
Hi Desire,
What version of the package are you using? Can you also include an example of your code?
Argument 4 is the 'metout' table from the microclimate model, and there must be NA values in it, which was happening in a version of the microclimate model recently after I made some changes for calculating dew. I think I sorted those issues out so you could reinstall the package if you haven't done this in a while via devtools::install_github('mrke/NicheMapR') and see if that fixes it. Also, take a look in metout and see what columns are giving NA values.
All the best,
Mike
